note: P is one poem four times: nacreous/mother-of-pearl light at dusk or dawn on cold air, with near-identical words and the same angle. Q has two near-duplicate lenticular ridge poems (Q2/Q3) and two near-duplicate dusk-veil poems (Q1/Q4), so it is really two ideas, but those two ideas do differ (wind and snow smell versus pearl and rose burning).
